'''Crat Dakerno''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] military strategist in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He traveled with a [[Troop/Legends|troop]] contingent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ab'Bshingh]] where he studied the two native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Waroot]] and the [[Farang]]s. Drawing on their tribal rituals and centuries-old tactics, he created the [[holo boardgame]] [[B'shingh]].<ref name="ACPOV" />
